svg.title: ParticleLab square symmetry: the mean can be a density valley
svg.desc: Analytic static square-model density ratios with exact mean and modes; all12 time points of positive-sign probability for selected8/4096 particle runs. Symmetry keeps exact sign mass 1/2 while a finite particle approximation can lose a sign. No calibrated confidence or general budget ranking.
